ai.seo_question: What is the consequence for a woman who lets an outsider into her home according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In al-Kafi, this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) underscores the gravity of 'khalwah' (seclusion) and the breach of domestic privacy, linking the intrusion of an outsider to the consumption of household sustenance and the exposure of 'awrah'. It serves as a foundational text in Shia jurisprudence for understanding the ethical boundaries of gender interaction within the private sphere, emphasizing that modesty extends beyond clothing to include the sanctity of one's home and provisions.
